raw_text: Fact Check: A viral video claiming a Bollywood superstar endorsed a PM candidate is FAKE. Our analysis confirms the video is a deepfake generated using face-swap technology. Key findings: (1) the face region has different compression artifacts than the rest of the frame, (2) lip movements do not match the audio waveform, (3) the original unedited clip was traced to a 2022 award show appearance. The video was first shared on Telegram and rapidly amplified across platforms.
clean_text: Fact check confirms viral Bollywood endorsement video is deepfake. Face-swap technology detected via compression artifacts, lip-audio mismatch. Original clip traced to 2022 award show.
